question: Why can admin not view Dashboard (Syntax error) in UntisX (endpoint /auth/login)?
answer: Check role admin. Module Dashboard may require higher permissions. Error Syntax error: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /auth/login and the database connection. Feature Dashboard must be enabled.
